entries.title: Break a new guard on purpose before trusting it
entries.content: After writing any guard, introduce the fault it targets, confirm the non-zero exit AND the exact message, then restore. Match the invocation, never a filename that a bystander line also mentions, and tolerate line wrapping in prose matches. Add the case to scripts/zeus-drift-guard-test.mjs so it stays proven.
entries.evidence: Weakening HARNESS_INVOCATION to a filename match made 2 of 16 cases in scripts/zeus-drift-guard-test.mjs fail; a literal-space CLAUDE.md regex failed the baseline case.

entries.title: No Zeus self-check runs in CI; only pnpm test does
entries.content: zeus:test, zeus:validate and zeus:drift are wired into no workflow. A new Zeus check is enforced only if it is a vitest suite collected by vitest.config.ts, which pnpm test runs in .github/workflows/ci.yml. Anything else is convention, so say so rather than calling it a gate.
entries.evidence: grep -rn zeus .github/workflows/ returns nothing; ci.yml job test runs pnpm test

entries.title: Find the reviewer a diff actually requires
entries.content: Do not guess which reviewer agent to dispatch. Run the command in reference: it maps the changed paths through .zeus/impact-map.json to module ids and through .zeus/module-manifest.json to reviewer agents, and reports matched false rather than an empty set when it cannot tell.
entries.evidence: pnpm zeus:gate reviewers on packages/arqfs paths returns arq-file-integrity-reviewer and arq-security-ai-reviewer

entries.title: Regenerate the engineering context when a repository source changes
entries.content: Engineering OS hashes a fixed set of repository-scope files. Editing any of them, package.json included, makes engineering/ops/generated/engineering-context-v5.json stale and fails the engineering-gate preflight job. Run pnpm engineering:context:build in the same change and commit the result. Run pnpm engineering:context:verify before pushing rather than learning it from red CI.
entries.evidence: PR 314 preflight failed at c9a3321; verify-engineering-context.mjs reported stale and only the package.json hash had moved

refinements.trigger: record the three durable lessons the prime-agent integration proved
refinements.rationale: Each is backed by a command run in this session, not by recollection: the guard-mutation probes, a grep over the workflows, and the reviewer match output itself.
refinements.expectedOutcome: A later turn stops writing guards that match bystander strings, stops assuming a Zeus check is enforced, and knows how to find the reviewer a diff requires. Validate with: pnpm zeus:harness format
